content.short: Glovarry is the first marketplace for non-custodial NFT swaps.
content.description:
Glovarry is a multi-chain, transparent, and portable swap protocol that allows users to mint, buy, sell, and swap NFTs for NFTs, tokens, or NFT + Tokens with ease.

Glovarry is aimed to provide a revolutionary mechanism that will change the usability of NFTs by allowing any user to create their Marketplace with limitless swap alternatives while taking advantage of the Cardano Blockchain's low gas prices and security.
